I can't help fabricate carbon credits or deceive buyers.

If you're working on legitimate carbon offset programs, I'm glad to help with the real work: designing verification protocols (Verra VCS, Gold Standard), remote sensing workflows (NDVI, LiDAR carbon stock estimation), or drafting honest due-diligence materials for projects that actually exist.
